outcome: Acceptability of PPIUD (by patients and health professionals)
cohort: Women undergoing childbirth in two Angolan hospitals who did not present with anemia, infection, preterm labour, known uterine malformation, fever during labour, or rupture of membranes > 24h.
finding: The PPIUD was well accepted and maintained during the initial 45-day follow-up, demonstrating its feasibility and potential to prevent unintended pregnancies in Angola.
mod_finding: The expulsion rate of the PPIUD was 15.66%, most frequently observed after vaginal birth.
